title: Same Monday. Two Lives. 💔 #shorts
description:
If you're 30, you've lived over 1,500 Mondays. How many do you actually remember?

Top: he hits snooze. Every. Single. Monday.
Bottom: he gets up and changes one small thing.

Same alarm. Same room. Years later… only one of them has something to show for it. 🌱

Same day? Change one thing.

💬 What's the ONE thing you'll change this Monday?
